catalogue: public/data/gyms.a78b7d75ae.json (506 venues, builtAt 2026-10-15, Overture 2026-09-23.1, OSM legacy snapshot, no research file)
method: Read-only. (1) Replayed normalise, deny-list, inferCounties and assemble in memory with the project's own modules and checked the result equals the published build. (2) Judged all 15 published merges and all 38 predicted web links, using a replay with the 128 research candidates. (3) Gave a verdict for every one of the 59 review-candidates. (4) Hunted for missed merges across all 506 published venues: same normalised phone, same own-domain host, same Facebook/Instagram page, Jaccard >= 0.5 or near-identical squashed names within 300 m, and distinctive-name matches up to 5 km and nationwide. (5) Hunted for false merges via phones and hosts shared by several records (switchboards, chain numbers) in the published and research replays. (6) Checked ids, slugs and aliases against slugify(), the publish code and the app. Web checks: feelfitnesscenter.org fetched; searches for Samnick, Alpha Fit, Dayah, Figure 8, Arena (Sarit) and Physiq & Tone.

ruleWeaknesses: Place and kind words count as name tokens ('nairobi', 'kenya', 'yoga', 'hotel'). They cause the Bikram/Delight merge, the Eka/Jacaranda web merge and the Nairobi Club tie, and make 'Fitness & Gym Kenya' vs 'Platinum Fitness Kenya' reach 0.50. Tested offline: adding Kenyan town names plus yoga, hotel, gymnasium, gyms, spa, wellness and sport(s) to STOP keeps all 8 correct name+distance merges at >= 0.5 (Dojo and AICAD rise to 1.0) and drops all four bad pairs to <= 0.25.
One-word brand names are not compared ('Smartgyms' vs 'Smart Gyms', 'NextLevel' vs 'Next Level'). A space-insensitive comparison of the squashed names would catch them.

Web findings placed at a town centroid are all 0 m apart, so approxMatch merges chain branches on a shared site host or head-office phone (SmartGyms, Legacy Fitness, AFROFIT; PrideInn only by luck). For two web records, require the same URL path, or compare their `area` / `address`, before merging on a contact.
There is no keep-apart override: merge.json can only force merges, so a reviewer cannot undo Bikram/Delight without a code change.

Geocoder placeholder points (Nairobi -1.28333,36.81667; Mombasa -4.05,39.6667; Kakamega 0.28333,34.75) create 0 m review noise (10 of the 43 proximity pairs). They can also become a merged venue's location (Bulldog). Detect stacked identical coordinates and treat them as approximate.
Primary name: OSM always wins the name, even its typo 'Mom3mtum' over 'MOM3NTUM Fitness' (whose domain is mom3ntum.com).

Wrong pins are behind most of the missed merges: Feel Fitness 27 km, Banana House 26 km, Smart Gyms Diamond Plaza 3.9 km, Dennison 15 km, RDF Rongai about 60 km, Smart Gyms Hub Karen in Ngong. A shared contact beyond 2 km goes to review, which is right, but a matching address string with a distant pin is not flagged at all.

fixtureResults.reproduction: Replaying build-gyms steps 1-2 in memory over data/source/* gives exactly the published result: 521 records -> 506 venues, 15 merge links (name+distance 9, phone 2, phone+name 3, website 1), 59 review pairs. The published file is gyms.a78b7d75ae.json, built 2026-10-15, with no research file (researchAt null).

mustMerge.detail: AICAD gym, DOJO, Level 24, Physiq & Tone Gym, Rox Park Gym Diani True Fitness, The Colosseum Fitness Centre and The Fitness Cocoon are each ONE venue. Each keeps its OSM id and OSM location, carries the Overture id in aliases, and has trust.sources [osm, overture]. Zeal Fitness and MOM3NTUM are two extra correct OSM+Overture matches (bySource osm+overture 9).

proximityOnly.detail: Fahari/Samnick (21 m, #4), Racing Sport/Ultra Smart Controls (51 m, #8) and Veteran/Cool Gym Equipment (39 m, #7; the ghost carries removedBy denylist) are all separate venues and all reason proximity-only. FAIL on one part: `node scripts/data/diff-report.mjs` prints only '59 review pairs (proximity-only 43, name-near 7, shared-contact-distant 9)' and never names a pair (grep finds none of the six names). The brief asks for them to be listed.

mergedVenues.note: The build has only 15 merged venues (all two-record clusters), so all 15 were judged. The predicted web links (38) bring the merge decisions judged to 53 (>= 40).

idsAndSlugs.detail: FAIL: the app never reads `aliases`. src/data/loadVenues.ts builds bySlug and byId from current values only; /gym/:slug looks up bySlug; there is no public/_redirects; prerender writes current slugs only. So the 477 carried old slugs and the 15 absorbed ids do not resolve: an old shared link to /gym/<old-slug> finds nothing, and Compare silently drops a stored absorbed id. Also, 477 of 506 slugs changed hash since the previous build. The previous gyms file is deleted on publish and git was out of scope, so the old id form could not be checked.
stabilityRisks: The primary id comes from rank (OSM > Overture confidence), so a future OSM match flips a venue's id from gers: to osm: and changes its slug.
Olympia's two Overture copies are at 0.57 vs 0.56, so the next release can swap the primary id and slug.

research.method: All 128 candidates in data/research/candidates/*.json were combined into a scratch venues-researched.json and replayed through the real pipeline in memory (normalise, deny-list, inferCounties, assemble). Nothing in data/ was written.
correctNotes: All 32 seed-id links point at the right record, including web:chains-002 -> gers:123e2d98 (Diamond Plaza) and web:nbo-cbd-south-001 -> gers:81bdb231 (Zoezi Gym and Spa is The Boma Nairobi's club).
Same-venue findings researched twice join correctly: Weston (institutions-002 + nbo-cbd-south-003) and Serena Beach (chains-018 + institutions-014).

fixtureResults.unitTests: npx vitest run on merge-rules, import-research, publish and diff-report: 4 files, 58 tests passed. They encode the 164 m 'flag, don't merge' rule and the three proximity pairs, but no test covers place-name tokens, one-word names, branch placement at a town centroid, or alias resolution in the app.
